hypothesis: The fixed SVD exposure catalog may be a major bottleneck. Learn a nonlinear exposure likelihood from every historical candidate display, while anchoring the item coordinates to their existing frame, then transfer the changed catalog into the incumbent click predictor.
data: Only real displayed candidates strictly before each cutoff; no future displays or outcomes. 10 positive exposures/event,40 global frequency-noise samples, exact NCE noise-density correction.
training: Two catalog anchor precisions20 and80; independent exposure-user8D factors and intercepts plus item intercept. Start exposure-user vectors at regularized inverse-covariance mean display profiles. Six fixed Adam epochs, lr.02 cosine to.004, batch2048. All initial click-model user/item preferences and click exposure-user parameters remain unchanged.
priors: Exposure-user L2 precision1; exposure item anchored L2 precision20 or80; item-bias shift precision20 and user-intercept shift precision1. Loss per positive exposure.
prediction: 256 common antithetic Sobol samples; replace exposure catalog only. Compare against original using bounded.3 utility delta.
screen: Primary V142 proxy overall at least+.00005, first-day/delayed/third-day nonnegative, nonworse logloss. Freeze winner before secondary; require both dates and combined positive.
limits: Reused validation proxies; exact V142 heldout heads unavailable. Large public gain or rank not guaranteed.
